title: Node.js and npm
description: Run node and install packages with npm.
notes: Covers a node from the nodejs.org installer, from nvm, and from Homebrew (with the Homebrew pack, which comes with this one). Packages are installed into the project, and npm's cache in ~/.npm can be changed.

Not covered: ~/.npmrc, which can hold the keys of a private registry, so npm runs with its default settings; installing packages for the whole Mac (npm install -g); and the caches of yarn and pnpm. Record a pack on top of this one for those.
A package that compiles code when it is installed needs the Make pack as well.

recorded.by: sandbox-discover, with node 24 from the nodejs.org installer, then the same under the pack's folders alone
recorded.command: node main.js; npm install && npm test
